facts.text: Evan mentions that he turns to painting or going for a drive when stressed as a way to cope.

evidence.quote: When I'm stressed, I always turn to something comforting. But I've found that painting or going for a drive helps too!

facts.text: Sam acknowledges Evan's painting and expresses interest in trying a similar activity to manage stress.

evidence.quote: Wow Evan, that's an awesome painting! Good on you for finding a way to de-stress. I could really use something like that - maybe I'll give painting a go or find another calming hobby.

facts.text: Evan offers to help Sam get started with painting and recommends supplies if Sam is interested.

evidence.quote: Painting is super chill for calming down. Wanna give it a try? I can help you get started and recommend some supplies if you're interested.

facts.text: Sam expresses willingness to try painting and asks Evan for suggestions on basic supplies to get started.

evidence.quote: Sounds great, Evan! I want to give it a go and see if it relaxes me. Can you suggest some basic supplies for me to get started?
